items.headline: Chabad seeks permit for religious use on Fremont Ave
items.summary: The Zoning Administrator's September 30 agenda listed a use permit request to allow Chabad of Sunnyvale to operate a religious institution (Place of Assembly - Community Serving) inside an existing commercial building at 645 W. Fremont Avenue, which is zoned R-1.

items.headline: City Attorney appointment on closed session agenda
items.summary: The September 22 closed session agenda included a public employee appointment item for the position of City Attorney.

items.headline: Hearing on 408-unit housing project at El Camino Real
items.summary: The September 22 City Council agenda listed a public hearing on prezoning, annexation, and a subdivision map for 408 residential units at 451-475 El Camino Real, backed by an environmental impact report.
